condition: blocked route with smoke near pickup gate and vulnerable students needing assistance
safe_action: Move the class upwind through the covered walkway, keep the fire lane clear, assign support for vulnerable students, and confirm headcount at the assembly point.
checklist: Scan smoke direction before moving.
Keep students together and away from the responder lane.
Assign one adult or buddy pair to each vulnerable student.
Take attendance at the upwind assembly point.
Wait for official all-clear before re-entry.
consequence: Using the responder lane as a shortcut slows emergency access and can split the class; upwind movement preserves safety and accountability.
source: Elastic-compatible demo knowledge pack: school fire drill route guidance

condition: strong shaking near the bay with elder assistance and pet control
safe_action: Move inland or upward immediately, support the elder on the marked route, keep the pet controlled, and do not return to shore until an official all-clear.
checklist: Treat strong shaking as a natural warning.
Move away from the shoreline without waiting for more certainty.
Use vertical evacuation only if inland movement is blocked.
Keep medication and phone with the elder.
Listen for official all-clear before returning.
consequence: Waiting near the bay increases exposure to fast-arriving water; inland movement gives the household more time and options.
source: Elastic-compatible demo knowledge pack: coastal household tsunami drill

condition: ground-floor evacuation at night with rising moving water
safe_action: Move people, medicine, chargers, and lights above flood level before water reaches the threshold; do not cross moving water.
checklist: Move children and essentials to an upper floor or elevated safe area.
Keep shoes, flashlight, charger, and medicine together.
Avoid walking or driving through moving water.
Turn off power only if it is safe and dry to reach the switch.
Send a short status update before signal weakens.
consequence: Crossing a flooded street after dark can trap people in moving water; vertical movement preserves safety while waiting for official guidance.
source: Elastic-compatible demo knowledge pack: night flood vertical shelter guidance

condition: parent pickup pressure while wind warning is active
safe_action: Keep students inside assigned rooms, use controlled covered-gate pickup only when safe, maintain class rosters, and keep emergency access clear.
checklist: Hold classes in assigned indoor rooms during peak wind.
Release only through a covered controlled pickup point.
Confirm guardian identity before reunification.
Keep vehicle and emergency access lanes clear.
Send one concise parent update with timing and gate instructions.
consequence: Opening all gates may look faster but weakens accountability and exposes students to wind-driven debris.
source: Elastic-compatible demo knowledge pack: typhoon school reunification guidance

condition: heat index alert with vulnerable students or patients and unstable cooling
safe_action: Move vulnerable people to the coolest reachable room, start water and symptom checks, protect temperature-sensitive medicines, and escalate confusion or fainting immediately.
checklist: Prioritize elders, children, and people with chronic conditions.
Route people to the coolest shaded or ventilated room.
Check for confusion, fainting, hot skin, or worsening symptoms.
Protect insulin and temperature-sensitive medicines.
Prepare transport escalation for severe heat illness signs.
consequence: Waiting until people ask for help delays heat response; early cooling and repeated checks reduce escalation risk.
source: Elastic-compatible demo knowledge pack: clinic heat triage guidance

condition: primary corridor blocked during a school evacuation drill
safe_action: Follow the teacher to the alternate marked route, stay with the group, report anyone left behind, and do not open unknown doors near smoke.
checklist: Stay with the assigned class group.
Point classmates toward the alternate route only when the teacher confirms it.
Do not run into smoke or open hot/unknown doors.
Report missing classmates at assembly.
Wait for adult or official instructions.
consequence: Student-led shortcuts can split the group; staying with the confirmed alternate route protects accountability.
source: Elastic-compatible demo knowledge pack: role-based blocked-route drill
